title: CleanSlices catalog
description: The options the cleanslices CLI offers and how they relate. Rendering (template symbols, file excludes) lives in the template.json files; a consistency test keeps both in step. See ROADMAP.md.

catalogVersion.description: Format version. A CLI that finds a newer version than it supports asks to be updated; newer CLIs keep reading older versions.

concepts.description: What options are grouped by in prompts and in `cleanslices list`, in this order.

select.description: many: any number of options. onePerGroup: at most one option per group.

groups.description: Pick-one sets that other options may depend on, such as the database provider.

required.description: true: the group always has exactly one option (its default unless another is picked). false: it can be empty, meaning the seam's default implementation.

default.description: Id of the option used when none is picked. Only for required groups.

units.description: Everything the resolver can apply. The order is the order in prompts and in `cleanslices list`.

id.description: Kebab-case. The template symbol is the id with '-' replaced by '_', so it must also work as a C# identifier.

license.description: Printed when the option or choice value is selected (no hidden licenses, rule 9).

setting.description: Configuration key for the license key, generated empty.

choice.description: A sub-option: only matters when its unit is selected. Each value becomes a computed bool template symbol of the same name.

kind.description: option: picked by the user. hidden: added by the resolver when a selected unit requires what it provides. glue: added when every unit in `when` is selected.

group.description: Key of a group in `groups`. Only for concepts that select onePerGroup.

requires.description: Capabilities (or unit ids) that must be provided by a selected unit. Every unit provides its own id.

provides.description: Capabilities this unit provides, besides its own id.

conflicts.description: Unit ids or capabilities that can't be selected together with this unit.

samples.description: Whether the sample features support this unit. Default true; false needs a reason in the option's documentation.

when.description: Glue units only: applied when every listed unit is selected.
